headlines.summary: 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 22일 국회 산업통상중소벤처기업위원회에서 '대한민국과 미합중국 간 전략적투자의 운영 및 관리를 위한 특별법'에 따른 대미투자 사전보고를 하고 있다. /연합뉴스 산업통상부가 대미 투자 프로젝트 1호 사업으로 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소 건설 사업을 보고한 것으로 알려졌다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.summary: 비상장 중기 주식 매각 세율 최대 25% “양도세 내고나면 손에 쥐는 돈 없어” 매각가격·고용승계 등 암초에 표류도 기업 지속가능성 유지 수단 마련 시급 기술보증기금은 21일 서울 여의도 중소기업중앙회 K-비즈홀에서 열린 ‘2026 기업승계 M&A 브릿지 포럼’을 개최했다.  홍석희 기자 “회사를 팔아 노후자금을 마련하려 했는데 꿈도 못꿔요.

headlines.title: 정부, 국내도입 원유 ‘ 중동산 비중 ’ 절반 이하로 줄인다
headlines.summary: 중동外 수입시 발생 운임차액 지원금 현행 25%서 확대키로 미국·이란 전쟁에 따른 호르무즈 해협 운항 차질로 원유 수급 공급망에 큰 위기를 겪은 정부가 국내 도입 원유의 중동산 비중을 절반 이하로 줄이기로 했다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 '100% 환급 ' 재시행…12월까지 적용

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는
headlines.summary: 유가 및 주요국 통화긴축 따른 달러·엔 등 움직임에 영향 반도체發 수출 호조 지속…환율 상승 제어 요인으로 원·달러 환율이 재차 1350원 선으로 내려앉았다. 유가 흐름이 환율 향방의 핵심 변수로 자리 잡은 상황에서 미·이란 간 긴장 완화 기대감, 사우디아라비아의 원유 수출 확대 기대감 등이 작용하며 유가가 하락한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

headlines.title: 7월 출생아 2만4천명, 7년 만에 최대 … 연간 누적 17만명 넘어
headlines.summary: '하반기도 반등 흐름'…1∼7월 누적 출생아 증가율 역대 최고 병원 신생아실 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 올해 7월 태어난 아기가 7년 만에 가장 많은 수준을 기록했다. 출생아 수 증가 흐름이 이어지며 올해 연간 누적 출생아는 17만명을 넘었다.

headlines.title: [기자수첩] 2022년 소환 한 주택 공급절벽 정쟁
headlines.summary: "(주택가격이 급등한) 단기적 원인으로 보면 2022년, 즉 윤석열 정권이 들어서고 오세훈 시장이 당선된 해부터 허가와 착공 건수가 절반으로 줄었다. 이런 상황에서 부동산 토지거래 허가를 풀어서 특정 지역의 집값이 폭등했다" 이재명 대통령은 최근 기자회견에서 주택가격이 크게 오른 배경을 묻는 말에 전 정권과 야당 출신 현 서울시장의 정책을 탓했다.

key_headlines.title: ADB Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.2% on AI Semiconductor Export Strength
key_headlines.summary: The Asian Development Bank upgraded Korea's economic growth forecast to 3.2% for this year, up 0.6 percentage points from July projections, citing robust AI semiconductor exports and recovering private consumption. Next year's growth forecast was also revised upward to 2.3% from 2.0%.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's Growth Outlook to 3.7%, Highest Among Major Forecasters
key_headlines.summary: The OECD significantly raised Korea's 2026 growth forecast to 3.7%, the highest projection among major institutions, reflecting strong production and export performance. This represents a 2.0 percentage point increase from March's forecast of 1.7%.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transactions Surge Below 600 Million Won as Buyers Target Policy Loan Threshold
key_headlines.summary: Over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions have fallen below the 600 million won policy lending cutoff, with transaction volume jumping 11% year-over-year. Rising jeonse prices and tightened lending regulations are pushing buyers toward lower-priced properties to qualify for government-backed loans.

key_headlines.title: Korea-US Nuclear Cooperation Expands with 8-Reactor Project Including Korean APR1400
key_headlines.summary: South Korea and the US are pursuing construction of eight nuclear reactors in America, including six Westinghouse AP1000 units and two Korean APR1400 reactors. The project represents Korea's second major US investment initiative and signals growing market opportunities for Korean nuclear technology.

key_headlines.title: LG Electronics and SK Enmove Jointly Develop Next-Generation AI Data Center Cooling Technology
key_headlines.summary: LG Electronics and SK Enmove partnered to develop advanced thermal management technology for AI data centers, including refrigerants, refrigeration oils, and immersion cooling solutions. The collaboration addresses growing demand for efficient cooling systems as AI infrastructure investments accelerate.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic growth outlook has been substantially upgraded by multiple international institutions due to strong AI semiconductor export performance. The ADB raised its 2026 growth forecast to 3.2%, while OECD set an even higher projection at 3.7%, reflecting robust semiconductor and technology-driven exports. Private consumption is also showing signs of recovery, contributing to improved economic momentum. However, inflation forecasts remain elevated at around 2.7%, presenting a balancing factor in Korea's economic picture. These upgrades mark consecutive positive revisions within recent months, signaling growing confidence in Korea's economic trajectory.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Multiple forecasting institutions have substantially revised Korea's economic growth estimates upward, with the OECD projecting 3.7% growth and ADB forecasting 3.2%, both significantly above government and central bank estimates. These upgrades reflect strong semiconductor exports and AI-related investment momentum driving GDP expansion. However, the US long-term Treasury yield spread has narrowed to its lowest level since March of last year, indicating potential economic deceleration signals from global markets. Inflation is projected to remain stable around 2.7%, though energy price volatility presents uncertainty. The Bank of Korea and government estimates continue to show more conservative projections than international institutions.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market recovered to above 7000 on the KOSPI index, with investor cash reserves rebounding to exceed 100 trillion won as semiconductor stocks led the rally. Foreign investors continue net buying, particularly focused on semiconductor and AI-related stocks despite broader market uncertainties. US 10-year Treasury yields remain elevated near 5%, supporting higher interest rates that create mixed dynamics for equity markets. The won-dollar exchange rate has returned to around 1350 won per dollar, as semiconductor export strength provides support against currency appreciation. ETF flows show extreme divergence as investors navigate uncertain market conditions amid geopolitical tensions and monetary policy changes.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor and AI-related technology exports continue driving economic growth, with major companies expanding global market presence. Daewoo Engineering and Construction is leveraging 50 years of international experience to expand in nuclear power and energy infrastructure markets, particularly in Vietnam. The nation is developing advanced cooling technologies for AI data centers through LG Electronics and SK Enmove collaboration to address rapidly growing infrastructure demands. Additionally, Korea is positioning itself in the global supply chain for advanced batteries and materials as demand intensifies. Electric vehicle charging infrastructure is being expanded ahead of peak travel periods, with mobile charging services deployed at major highways.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market is experiencing significant pricing pressure below the 600 million won policy lending threshold, with over 22% of transactions occurring at this level as buyers seek government-backed loan eligibility. Jeonse prices have surged substantially, pushing renters toward monthly rental arrangements averaging 2 million won or higher in Seoul. Post-Chuseok, 26 apartment complexes with 17,841 units are scheduled for launch across the Seoul metropolitan area, with large projects concentrated in Gyeonggi's southern regions where prices have risen sharply. Consumer sentiment regarding house price expectations remains elevated at 133, indicating sustained buyer optimism despite policy measures. Low-priced apartments are facing potential extinction as the market bifurcates based on lending policy thresholds.
sections.International Economy: US-Iran diplomatic talks have resumed at the UN, with three-hour discussions suggesting potential progress toward conflict resolution and lifting market risk premiums. Trump and Xi Jinping are meeting in Washington for the first state visit in eleven years, with AI cooperation, trade disputes, and Taiwan issues expected to dominate discussions. US semiconductor stocks and AI-related companies benefit from tariff negotiation uncertainties, as semiconductor sector strength could influence bilateral trade outcomes. Nasdaq reached record highs despite broader market volatility, driven by AI sector momentum offsetting concerns about elevated interest rates. Global energy markets show easing tensions with US-Iran dialogue improving, potentially moderating crude oil prices and reducing geopolitical risk premiums.
sections.AI & Economy: AI-driven data center investments are accelerating globally, with major Korean companies positioning themselves in this high-growth sector through technology development and financing initiatives. LG Electronics and SK Enmove's collaboration on cooling technology addresses the critical thermal management challenges facing expanding AI infrastructure. Woori Financial Group secured project financing for a 600 billion won AI data center development in Pohang, targeting completion by end of 2027. Global tech companies continue committing to sustained AI infrastructure investment through 2028 despite concerns about capital availability. AI-related exports from semiconductor manufacturers like South Korea and Japan are driving significant economic growth contributions as data center buildout accelerates worldwide.
sections.Others: The Customs Service expanded whistleblower incentive programs by eliminating upper limits on reward amounts and introducing tiered payment structures up to 3x multipliers for major insider tips. Yeongwol Sangdong Mine in Gangwon Province resumed commercial tungsten production for the first time in 30 years following facility inspections, positioning Korea for increased domestic supply and export of critical minerals.
